digitized.method: native 1-bit page scan (5060×6898 px); axis calibration from the inner tick marks on all four frame sides (bilinear, max tick residual 1.2 px = 0.00007 in η); polyline vertices from straight-line fits of each segment (rms ≤ 0.9 px) evaluated at the error-bar x; bar caps = centre rows of the cap strokes; read-off uncertainty ≈ ±0.0002 in η, ±0.001 in Δg
